$comment: What a theme can override, for `entirius list` (pnpm overrides): grouped by where it shows in the shop, one line each. `more`: smaller parts, shown with --all; `compact`: the group is one line without --all. Every file in src/ (but lib/) has an entry: overrides.test.ts checks it.

items.tokens.css: palette, corners, picture ratio, catalogue columns

groups.title: Product card
groups.where: catalogue, search, similar products, CMS tiles

items.components/product-card: the card: picture, labels, name, price, the + button
items.components/product-price: price, struck old price, lowest 30-day price
items.components/product-badges: labels on the picture: discount, New, …
items.components/quick-add: the card's + button: one unit into the cart
items.components/wishlist-button: the heart on cards and on the product page

more.components/product-thumb: small picture in cart, checkout and search rows

items.product/product-page: which parts the page has, in what order
items.product/header: brands, labels, name, key facts, SKU
items.product/variant-picker: options such as size or series
items.product/buy-box: quantity, Add to cart, wishlist, back-in-stock form
items.product/sticky-buy-bar: buy bar on phones once the buy box scrolls away

more.product/gallery-utils: gallery helpers: picture sizes and positions

items.catalog/listing-page: which parts the list has, in what order
items.catalog/filters: filter panel: sorting, ranges, values, Apply
items.catalog/filters-sheet: filters on phones: a button and a side panel
items.catalog/filter-options: a filter by values: checkboxes with counts
items.catalog/filter-range: a filter by range: slider and bounds
items.catalog/listing-empty: nothing found; a notify-me form in a category

groups.title: Cart
groups.where: /cart; the order parts also in checkout

items.cart/cart-page: which parts the cart has, in what order
items.cart/cart-line: a line: picture, name, prices, quantity, remove
items.cart/cart-summary: summary column: code, totals, to checkout
items.cart/cart-bar: total and to checkout, fixed on phones
items.order/page-header: title row; the empty cart (also checkout)
items.order/unit-price: unit price, struck regular price, −N% (also checkout)
items.order/order-totals: totals: subtotal, savings, delivery, total (also checkout)

groups.title: CMS pages
groups.where: home, CMS pages, the blog intro, post bodies, footer columns

items.cms/section-hero-slider: hero: slides in a carousel, or one slide
items.cms/tile-hero: a hero slide: copy beside its picture
items.cms/section-text: title, text and a grid of tiles
items.cms/section-product-slider: products: hand-picked or a category’s first

more.cms/section-shell: a section’s heading row: title, text, buttons
more.cms/section-type-a: older content’s section; footer link columns
more.cms/tile-product: a product in a CMS product section
more.cms/product-rail: product cards in a row or a grid
more.cms/picture: a CMS picture in its ratio box

groups.title: Blog
groups.where: /blog, posts, authors; post tiles also on CMS pages

items.blog/blog-page: the list: intro, category tabs, posts, pages
items.blog/post-page: a post: which parts, in what order
items.blog/post-tile: a post on a list: cover, title, summary, date

more.blog/post-grid: a page of post tiles, or none
more.blog/pending-label: a tab’s text pulsing while it loads

groups.title: Checkout
groups.where: /checkout; its forms, delivery and payment stay in the core

items.checkout/checkout-summary: summary beside the steps: lines, code, totals
items.checkout/order-receipt: the receipt: numbers, amount, payment, delivery

items.account/account-layout: the account’s frame: menu beside the page
items.account/overview-page: the overview: which parts, in what order
items.account/order-page: one order: which parts, in what order
items.account/address-card: a saved address with its actions
items.components/message-page: e-mail link results: activation, reset, newsletter

more.account/page-heading: a sub-page’s back link and title
more.account/order-section: an order section’s icon and heading

items.layout/header: the whole header, the order of its parts
items.layout/menu: which menu shows on phones and on desktop
items.layout/hamburger-menu: category list in a side panel
items.layout/search-bar: search on desktop: a field in the header
items.layout/search-sheet: search on phones: a panel from the top
items.layout/account-nav: account icon: profile link or sign-in panel
items.layout/notices: short notices: added to cart, errors

more.layout/count-badge: number on the cart and wishlist icons
more.layout/header-icon: shared look of the header icons
more.layout/search-field: search box shared by desktop and phones
more.layout/search-product-row: a product row in search suggestions
more.layout/wishlist-items: the list inside the wishlist panel

groups.title: UI elements
groups.where: every page and form, the checkout's too

items.ui/form-fields: a field with its label and error (TextField, …)
items.ui/input-group: a field with an icon or a button inside
